WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    totals.pageviews,
    SAFE_CAST(totals.transactions AS INT64) as transactions,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as month
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170601' AND '20170731'
    AND totals.pageviews IS NOT NULL
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    fullVisitorId,
    month,
    pageviews,
    CASE WHEN transactions IS NOT NULL AND transactions > 0 THEN 'purchase' ELSE 'non_purchase' END as classification
  FROM sessions
),
visitor_month_class AS (
  SELECT
    fullVisitorId,
    month,
    classification,
    SUM(pageviews) as total_pageviews
  FROM classified
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId, month, classification
),
averages AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    classification,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(total_pageviews), COUNT(*)) as avg_pageviews
  FROM visitor_month_class
  GROUP BY month, classification
)
SELECT
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', month) as month,
  MAX(CASE WHEN classification = 'purchase' THEN avg_pageviews END) as avg_pageviews_purchase,
  MAX(CASE WHEN classification = 'non_purchase' THEN avg_pageviews END) as avg_pageviews_non_purchase
FROM averages
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

WITH station_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    stn,
    SUM(CASE WHEN temp IS NOT NULL AND temp != 9999.9 AND max IS NOT NULL AND max != 9999.9 AND min IS NOT NULL AND min != 9999.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as valid_days,
    COUNT(*) as total_days
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022`
  WHERE stn != '999999'
  GROUP BY stn
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as qualifying_count 
  FROM station_stats 
  WHERE SAFE_DIVIDE(valid_days, 365) >= 0.90
),
all_stations AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count FROM station_stats
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(q.qualifying_count, a.total_count) * 100, 2) as percentage
FROM qualifying q, all_stations a

WITH complaint_totals AS (
  SELECT complaint_type, COUNT(*) as total_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2020
  GROUP BY complaint_type
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 3000
),
daily_complaints AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(DATE FROM created_date) as dt,
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as type_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2020
  GROUP BY dt, complaint_type
),
daily_totals AS (
  SELECT dt, SUM(type_count) as daily_total
  FROM daily_complaints
  GROUP BY dt
),
daily_proportions AS (
  SELECT 
    dc.dt,
    dc.complaint_type,
    CAST(dc.type_count AS FLOAT64) / CAST(dt.daily_total AS FLOAT64) as proportion
  FROM daily_complaints dc
  JOIN daily_totals dt ON dc.dt = dt.dt
  WHERE dc.complaint_type IN (SELECT complaint_type FROM complaint_totals)
),
wind_data AS (
  SELECT 
    PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)) as dt,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) as wdsp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE stn = '744860' AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2020'
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.complaint_type,
    dp.dt,
    dp.proportion,
    wd.wdsp
  FROM daily_proportions dp
  JOIN wind_data wd ON dp.dt = wd.dt
  WHERE wd.wdsp IS NOT NULL AND dp.proportion IS NOT NULL
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as n,
    SUM(proportion) as sum_x,
    SUM(wdsp) as sum_y,
    SUM(proportion * proportion) as sum_x2,
    SUM(wdsp * wdsp) as sum_y2,
    SUM(proportion * wdsp) as sum_xy
  FROM combined
  GROUP BY complaint_type
),
correlations AS (
  SELECT 
    complaint_type,
    (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / 
      SQRT((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y)) as pearson_r
  FROM stats
  WHERE n > 0
    AND (n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) > 0
    AND (n * sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y) > 0
)
SELECT complaint_type, pearson_r, ROUND(pearson_r, 4) as rounded_r
FROM correlations
WHERE complaint_type IN ('HEAT/HOT WATER', 'Outdoor Dining')

WITH nyc_zips AS (
  SELECT zip_code, zip_code_geom
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes`
  WHERE state_code = 'NY'
),
trips AS (
  SELECT 
    pickup_datetime,
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM pickup_datetime) as hour,
    pickup_longitude,
    pickup_latitude
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2015`
  WHERE pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL 
    AND pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND pickup_longitude != 0 
    AND pickup_latitude != 0
),
trip_with_zip AS (
  SELECT 
    t.pickup_datetime,
    t.hour,
    z.zip_code
  FROM trips t
  LEFT JOIN nyc_zips z
    ON ST_CONTAINS(z.zip_code_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(t.pickup_longitude, t.pickup_latitude))
  WHERE z.zip_code IS NOT NULL
),
jan1_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    zip_code, 
    hour,
    COUNT(*) as total_trips
  FROM trip_with_zip
  WHERE DATE(pickup_datetime) = '2015-01-01'
  GROUP BY zip_code, hour
),
zip_hours AS (
  SELECT z.zip_code, h.hour
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT zip_code FROM nyc_zips) z
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT 0 as hour UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 
              UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 
              UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 
              UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15 
              UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 
              UNION ALL SELECT 20 UNION ALL SELECT 21 UNION ALL SELECT 22 UNION ALL SELECT 23) h
),
base AS (
  SELECT 
    zh.zip_code,
    zh.hour,
    COALESCE(jc.total_trips, 0) as total_trips
  FROM zip_hours zh
  LEFT JOIN jan1_counts jc ON zh.zip_code = jc.zip_code AND zh.hour = jc.hour
),
with_lookback AS (
  SELECT 
    b.zip_code,
    b.hour,
    b.total_trips,
    COALESCE(jc_1h.total_trips, 0) as trips_1h_ago,
    0 as trips_1d_ago,
    0 as trips_7d_ago,
    0 as trips_14d_ago
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN jan1_counts jc_1h 
    ON b.zip_code = jc_1h.zip_code 
    AND b.hour - 1 = jc_1h.hour
)
SELECT 
  zip_code,
  hour,
  total_trips,
  trips_1h_ago,
  trips_1d_ago,
  trips_7d_ago,
  trips_14d_ago,
  SAFE_CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) as moving_avg_14day,
  SAFE_CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) as moving_avg_21day,
  SAFE_CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) as std_dev_14day,
  SAFE_CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) as std_dev_21day
FROM with_lookback
ORDER BY total_trips DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH daily_data AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    new_confirmed,
    LAG(new_confirmed) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS prev_new_confirmed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
  WHERE country_code = 'US' AND aggregation_level = 0 
    AND date BETWEEN '2020-03-01' AND '2020-04-30'
)
SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%m-%d', date) AS mm_dd
FROM daily_data
WHERE prev_new_confirmed IS NOT NULL AND prev_new_confirmed > 0
ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(new_confirmed - prev_new_confirmed, prev_new_confirmed) DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH yearly_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN date >= '2019-01-01' AND date <= '2019-12-31' THEN '2019'
      WHEN date >= '2020-01-01' AND date <= '2020-12-31' THEN '2020'
    END as year,
    AVG(SAFE_CAST(symptom_anosmia AS FLOAT64)) as avg_anosmia
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_symptom_search.symptom_search_sub_region_2_weekly`
  WHERE sub_region_1 = 'New York' 
    AND sub_region_2 IN ('Bronx County', 'Queens County', 'Kings County', 'New York County', 'Richmond County')
    AND date >= '2019-01-01' AND date <= '2020-12-31'
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT 
  SAFE_DIVIDE(avg_2020.avg_anosmia - avg_2019.avg_anosmia, avg_2019.avg_anosmia) * 100 as pct_change
FROM yearly_avgs avg_2019
JOIN yearly_avgs avg_2020 ON 1=1
WHERE avg_2019.year = '2019' AND avg_2020.year = '2020'

WITH zip_pop AS (
  SELECT 
    zipcode,
    SUM(population) AS total_population
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_usa.population_by_zip_2010`
  WHERE gender IN ('male', 'female')
    AND minimum_age IS NULL 
    AND maximum_age IS NULL
  GROUP BY zipcode
)
SELECT 
  za.zipcode,
  za.zipcode_geom AS polygon,
  za.area_land_meters,
  za.area_water_meters,
  za.latitude,
  za.longitude,
  za.state_code,
  za.state_name,
  za.city,
  za.county,
  zp.total_population
FROM `bigquery-public-data.utility_us.zipcode_area` za
JOIN zip_pop zp ON za.zipcode = zp.zipcode
WHERE ST_DWITHIN(
  ST_GEOGFROM(za.zipcode_geom),
  ST_GEOGFROM('POINT (-122.3321 47.6062)'),
  10000
)

WITH p2011 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, total_pop, median_income 
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2011_5yr` 
  WHERE geo_id LIKE '36047%' AND total_pop > 1000
),
p2018 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, total_pop, median_income 
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr` 
  WHERE geo_id LIKE '36047%' AND total_pop > 1000
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    p2011.geo_id,
    p2011.total_pop AS pop_2011,
    p2018.total_pop AS pop_2018,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(p2018.total_pop - p2011.total_pop, p2011.total_pop) AS pop_pct_increase,
    p2011.median_income AS income_2011,
    p2018.median_income AS income_2018,
    p2018.median_income - p2011.median_income AS income_abs_increase
  FROM p2011
  JOIN p2018 ON p2011.geo_id = p2018.geo_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    geo_id,
    pop_2011,
    pop_2018,
    pop_pct_increase,
    income_2011,
    income_2018,
    income_abs_increase,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pop_pct_increase DESC) AS pop_pct_rank,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY income_abs_increase DESC) AS income_abs_rank
  FROM joined
)
SELECT * FROM ranked 
WHERE pop_pct_rank <= 20 AND income_abs_rank <= 20
ORDER BY pop_pct_rank

WITH year2000 AS (
  SELECT geoid, AVG(month3_emplvl_23_construction) AS avg_emplvl_2000
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2000_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN 'q1' AND 'q4'
    AND geoid LIKE '49%'
  GROUP BY geoid
),
year2018 AS (
  SELECT geoid, AVG(month3_emplvl_23_construction) AS avg_emplvl_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2018_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN 'q1' AND 'q4'
    AND geoid LIKE '49%'
  GROUP BY geoid
)
SELECT 
  c.county_name,
  y2000.avg_emplvl_2000,
  y2018.avg_emplvl_2018,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(y2018.avg_emplvl_2018 - y2000.avg_emplvl_2000, y2000.avg_emplvl_2000) * 100 AS pct_increase
FROM year2000 y2000
JOIN year2018 y2018 ON y2000.geoid = y2018.geoid
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.counties` c 
  ON c.county_fips_code = y2000.geoid
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH google_hiring AS (
  SELECT 
    race_asian AS asian,
    race_black AS black,
    race_hispanic_latinx AS hispanic,
    race_white AS white
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_hiring`
  WHERE report_year = 2021 AND workforce = 'overall'
),
bls_tech AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(percent_white) AS avg_white,
    AVG(percent_black_or_african_american) AS avg_black,
    AVG(percent_asian) AS avg_asian,
    AVG(percent_hispanic_or_latino) AS avg_hispanic
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpsaat18`
  WHERE year = 2021
  AND (
    subsector IN (
      'Internet publishing and broadcasting and web search portals',
      'Software publishers',
      'Data processing, hosting, and related services'
    )
    OR industry_group = 'Computer systems design and related services'
  )
),
race_diffs AS (
  SELECT 
    'White' AS race,
    g.white AS google_pct,
    b.avg_white AS bls_tech_avg,
    ABS(g.white - b.avg_white) AS pct_diff
  FROM google_hiring g, bls_tech b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    'Asian' AS race,
    g.asian AS google_pct,
    b.avg_asian AS bls_tech_avg,
    ABS(g.asian - b.avg_asian) AS pct_diff
  FROM google_hiring g, bls_tech b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    'Black or African American' AS race,
    g.black AS google_pct,
    b.avg_black AS bls_tech_avg,
    ABS(g.black - b.avg_black) AS pct_diff
  FROM google_hiring g, bls_tech b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    'Hispanic or Latino' AS race,
    g.hispanic AS google_pct,
    b.avg_hispanic AS bls_tech_avg,
    ABS(g.hispanic - b.avg_hispanic) AS pct_diff
  FROM google_hiring g, bls_tech b
)
SELECT 
  race,
  ROUND(google_pct, 4) AS google_percentage,
  ROUND(bls_tech_avg, 4) AS bls_tech_average,
  ROUND(pct_diff, 4) AS percentage_difference
FROM race_diffs
ORDER BY pct_diff DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS theft_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_crime.crime`
  WHERE primary_type = 'MOTOR VEHICLE THEFT'
    AND year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2016
  GROUP BY year, month
),
max_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    MAX(theft_count) AS highest_monthly_thefts
  FROM monthly_counts
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT 
  year,
  highest_monthly_thefts
FROM max_counts
ORDER BY year

SELECT
  TradeReportID AS tradeID,
  MaturityDate AS tradeTimestamp,
  CASE
    WHEN LEFT(TargetCompID, 4) = 'MOMO' THEN 'Momentum'
    WHEN LEFT(TargetCompID, 4) = 'LUCK' THEN 'Feeling Lucky'
    WHEN LEFT(TargetCompID, 4) = 'PRED' THEN 'Prediction'
  END AS algorithm,
  Symbol AS symbol,
  LastPx AS openPrice,
  StrikePrice AS closePrice,
  (SELECT s.Side FROM UNNEST(Sides) s LIMIT 1) AS tradeDirection,
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT s.Side FROM UNNEST(Sides) s LIMIT 1) = 'SHORT' THEN -1
    ELSE 1
  END AS tradeMultiplier
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cymbal_investments.trade_capture_report`
ORDER BY StrikePrice DESC
LIMIT 6

WITH condition_acres AS (
  SELECT 
    p.evaluation_group,
    p.evaluation_group_description,
    p.evaluation_type,
    p.evaluation_description,
    p.state_code,
    c.condition_status_code,
    SUM(p.expansion_factor * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot * c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted) AS total_subplot_acres,
    SUM(p.expansion_factor * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot * COALESCE(c.macroplot_proportion_unadjusted, 0)) AS total_macroplot_acres
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p 
    ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number 
    AND c.inventory_year = p.inventory_year 
    AND c.state_code = p.state_code
  WHERE c.inventory_year = 2012
    AND p.evaluation_group_description LIKE '%2012%'
    AND c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP'
  GROUP BY p.evaluation_group, p.evaluation_group_description, p.evaluation_type, p.evaluation_description, p.state_code, c.condition_status_code
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY evaluation_group ORDER BY total_subplot_acres DESC) AS rn
  FROM condition_acres
)
SELECT 
  evaluation_group_description AS evaluation_group,
  evaluation_type,
  CAST(condition_status_code AS STRING) AS condition_status_code,
  evaluation_description,
  CAST(state_code AS STRING) AS state_code,
  total_macroplot_acres AS macroplot_acres,
  total_subplot_acres AS subplot_acres
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY total_subplot_acres DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT

  SUM(CASE WHEN atmospheric_conditions_name = 'Rain' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rainy_accidents,

  (SUM(CASE WHEN atmospheric_conditions_name = 'Rain' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
   SUM(CASE WHEN atmospheric_conditions_name = 'Clear' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS diff
FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2016`
WHERE day_of_week IN (1, 7)
  AND year_of_crash = 2016
  AND atmospheric_conditions_name IN ('Rain', 'Clear')

WITH snap_agg AS (
  SELECT FIPS, SUM(SNAP_All_Participation_Households) as total_snap_households
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_snap_enrollment.snap_enrollment`
  WHERE Date = '2017-01-01'
  GROUP BY FIPS
)
SELECT 
  s.FIPS,
  f.GeoName,
  s.total_snap_households,
  c.income_less_10000 + c.income_10000_14999 + c.income_15000_19999 as income_under_20k,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(c.income_less_10000 + c.income_10000_14999 + c.income_15000_19999, s.total_snap_households) as ratio
FROM snap_agg s
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr` c
  ON s.FIPS = c.geo_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_bea_cainc30.fips` f
  ON s.FIPS = f.GeoFIPS AND f.Year = '2017-01-01'
WHERE s.total_snap_households > 0
ORDER BY s.total_snap_households DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH natality AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) AS birth_year,
    County_of_Residence_FIPS AS county_fips,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Maternal_Morbidity_YN = 1 THEN Births ELSE 0 END) AS no_morbidity_births,
    SUM(Births) AS total_births
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_maternal_morbidity`
  WHERE Year IN (DATE('2016-01-01'), DATE('2017-01-01'), DATE('2018-01-01'))
    AND Maternal_Morbidity_YN IN (0, 1)
  GROUP BY birth_year, county_fips
),
census_2015 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) AS poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2015_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
census_2016 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) AS poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2016_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
census_2017 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) AS poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    n.birth_year,
    CASE n.birth_year
      WHEN 2016 THEN c2015.poverty_rate
      WHEN 2017 THEN c2016.poverty_rate
      WHEN 2018 THEN c2017.poverty_rate
    END AS poverty_rate,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(n.no_morbidity_births, n.total_births) * 100 AS no_morbidity_pct
  FROM natality n
  LEFT JOIN census_2015 c2015 ON n.county_fips = c2015.geo_id AND n.birth_year = 2016
  LEFT JOIN census_2016 c2016 ON n.county_fips = c2016.geo_id AND n.birth_year = 2017
  LEFT JOIN census_2017 c2017 ON n.county_fips = c2017.geo_id AND n.birth_year = 2018
  WHERE n.total_births > 0
    AND (CASE n.birth_year
      WHEN 2016 THEN c2015.poverty_rate IS NOT NULL
      WHEN 2017 THEN c2016.poverty_rate IS NOT NULL
      WHEN 2018 THEN c2017.poverty_rate IS NOT NULL
    END)
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    birth_year,
    COUNT(*) AS n,
    SUM(poverty_rate) AS sum_x,
    SUM(no_morbidity_pct) AS sum_y,
    SUM(poverty_rate * no_morbidity_pct) AS sum_xy,
    SUM(POWER(poverty_rate, 2)) AS sum_x2,
    SUM(POWER(no_morbidity_pct, 2)) AS sum_y2
  FROM combined
  GROUP BY birth_year
)
SELECT 
  birth_year,
  ROUND(
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y,
      SQRT((n * sum_x2 - POWER(sum_x, 2)) * (n * sum_y2 - POWER(sum_y, 2)))
    ),
    6
  ) AS pearson_correlation
FROM stats
ORDER BY birth_year

WITH users_2021 AS (

user_first_question AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions`

),
users_asked_within_30 AS (
  SELECT 
    u.user_id,

  FROM users_2021 u
  INNER JOIN user_first_question fq ON u.user_id = fq.user_id
  WHERE fq.first_question_date <= TIMESTAMP_ADD(u.signup_date, INTERVAL 30 DAY)
),
user_first_answer_after_first_q AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a

  GROUP BY a.owner_user_id
),
monthly_stats AS (

  SELECT

    MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'ga_session_id' THEN ep.value.int_value END) AS ga_session_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_20210102` AS e,

  WHERE page_location IS NOT NULL

classified AS (
  SELECT 
    page_location,
    ga_session_id,
    CASE WHEN ARRAY_LENGTH(all_parts) < 5 THEN NULL
    ELSE
      CASE 
        WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(all_parts[OFFSET(ARRAY_LENGTH(all_parts) - 1)], r'\+') 
             AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(all_parts[OFFSET(3)]) || ' ' || LOWER(all_parts[OFFSET(4)]), r'(accessories|apparel|brands|campus collection|drinkware|electronics|google redesign|lifestyle|nest|new 2015 logo|notebooks journals|office|shop by brand|small goods|stationery|wearables)')

        THEN 'PLP'
        ELSE 'OTHER'

-- Final query: percentage of users who first opened in Sept 2018 and uninstalled within 7 days, that experienced a crash
WITH first_opens AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(CAST(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(event_timestamp) AS DATE)) AS first_open_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_201809*`
  WHERE event_name = 'first_open'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
uninstallers AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(CAST(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(event_timestamp) AS DATE)) AS uninstall_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_201809*`
  WHERE event_name = 'app_remove'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
qualifying_users AS (
  SELECT 
    fo.user_pseudo_id
  FROM first_opens fo
  JOIN uninstallers u ON fo.user_pseudo_id = u.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE DATE_DIFF(u.uninstall_date, fo.first_open_date, DAY) <= 7
    AND DATE_DIFF(u.uninstall_date, fo.first_open_date, DAY) >= 0
),
crashers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_201809*`
  WHERE event_name = 'app_exception'
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_pseudo_id), COUNT(DISTINCT q.user_pseudo_id)) * 100, 2) AS percentage
FROM qualifying_users q
LEFT JOIN crashers c ON q.user_pseudo_id = c.user_pseudo_id
